description: GET ONE TRIAL TO WORK ON: a completed clinical trial that never posted results to the registry, with title, sponsor, conditions, completion date and ready-made PubMed and Europe PMC search links. Search for the paper that reports it. NEXT: submit_results_gap with a PMID or DOI, or with outcome searched_none and the search you ran.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor. Pass _meta.pagination.nextCursor from the previous call unchanged to get the next page; omit it to start at the beginning.

disease.description: t1d, or any Lab disease id from list_lab_diseases, for that disease only.

mode.description: fresh or replicate. Omit to let the queue choose.

topic.description: Cure Protocol topic id, for example oncology.

name: next_results_gap_trial

_meta.description: source, generatedAt, sources (per-source lastSyncedAt and ageHours), rateLimit, disclaimer.

data.description: The answer. Shape depends on the tool; describe_tool documents it.
